entities.summary: Iftach Spector is a retired Israeli brigadier general, a former fighter pilot and commander of the airbases at Tel Nof and Ramat David. He serves on the Israel Advisory Council of the Israel Policy Forum. He is Israeli Air Force's fighter ace credited with 12 victories and was the leader of the attack against the USS Liberty which resulted in the deaths of 34 American crew members.
